paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak bar Zeira; in Yevamot (97a) and at the beginning of Bammeh Madlikin, Shabbat (20b): Rav Yitzḥak bar Ze'eira. In Shabbat (33b): R. Yitzḥak bar Ze'iri; so too in Bekhorot (31b). In Yelammedenu, Pinḥas, §13: bar Ze'eira. R. Hoshaya bar Simlai of Caesarea, in his name. R. Yehoshua, in the name of R. Yitzḥak son of R. Ze’eira, Yalkut Tehillim, §19 [the checked text, remez 673, reads R. Hoshaya].
